*Topics — What a work is about. The words are seeded from the clusters the reading-time triage of 2026-09-25 found, and grow by decision.*

**Compositionality** — how the structure and meaning of a whole come from its parts and how they are combined — the principle of compositionality and compositional semantics, the emergence of compositional structure in languages under transmission, and composition and binding in learned models (generalization to unseen combinations, attribute binding, composing distributions or concepts). A work on making a model generalize compositionally is ML practice and goes to the anthology (ADR-031).

| [CLAIM-480](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-480.md) v2 | Composition turns an interior into a constraint | From A22 §4 and A23 §IV of the exchange of 2026-10-27, which called composition "the most important missing mechanism" after the owner's U20. Eliminating an equilibrated interior leaves an effective boundary relation that no part has; an outside system interacting only with the boundary meets it as a constraint, and "The interior has effectively become apparatus." Baez and Fong's black-boxing functor is the general theorem for passive linear networks. The memory case ties it to Mori–Zwanzig and to [CLAIM-478](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-478.md): interconnection yields an effective constraint on the boundary's trajectories in every case, and separation of time scales decides only whether it is approximately memoryless. For cellular sheaves the reduction can need a richer relational vocabulary than the parts used (THEORY-1090; QUESTION-283). It is independent evidence for [CLAIM-477](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-477.md), that constraints are realized by organization. | Active |
